about: Discovery Surf School is a family-run surf and SUP school in South Devon that has been operating since 2002. It teaches at Bigbury-on-Sea and Bantham, picking the break to suit the conditions. It caters for all ages and abilities, from families to school and club groups, and also hires out a wide range of kit.
offers: Surf lessons for all ages and abilities
Group lessons for schools, scouts, sports teams, language centres, stag and hen parties
Surf clubs, including an adult surf club
Hire: surfboards, bodyboards, wetsuits, paddleboards, kayaks and eFoils
goodToKnow: Lessons include a wetsuit and surfboard
Surfing England accredited for surfing; AALA registered for SUP
Instructors hold ASI or Surfing England qualifications, DBS checks and SLSGB beach lifeguard awards
Lesson times and surf checks are posted on a 'What's on this week' page
gaps: No season, what to bring or cancellation terms; age limits not given; lessons page not opened
